description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 data types. Types only — no async. Structs: FileNode (id, parentId, name, nodeType, mediaType, size, blobId, keywords, myRights, shareWith, description, cid, created, modified), NodeType enum (file/directory/symlink + Other(String) catch-all), FilesRights (6 boolean rights: mayRead/Write/Delete/Share/Rename/CreateChild), FileNodeRole constants (pub const &str for inbox/trash/templates/archive/sent/drafts), FileNodeFilterCondition (with type field renamed to media_type to avoid Rust keyword collision), FileNodeCapability. All camelCase serde. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13. Pattern: jmap-mail-types.
title: jmap-filenode-types: JMAP FileNode data types
